chief_complaint: Management of type 2 diabetes mellitus with hypertension, chronic kidney disease, and related complications
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 60-year-old Asian female with longstanding type 2 diabetes (diagnosed 2014) complicated by microalbuminuria, stage 2 chronic kidney disease, non‑proliferative diabetic retinopathy, and hypertriglyceridemia. Hypertension diagnosed in 2015 remains suboptimally controlled (DBP 94 mmHg). She has obesity (BMI >30 since 2003) and a 40‑year history of daily tobacco use despite nicotine‑patch therapy. Social stressors include intimate‑partner abuse, limited social contact, refugee status, and recent full‑time employment. Laboratory data are incomplete (missing eGFR, lipid panel, BMI) and the recorded A1c of 3.0% appears erroneous. Overall she exhibits a high‑risk metabolic‑cardiovascular profile with multiple modifiable risk factors.
